basic_info.description: This is it, YOUR NEW HOME! Welcome to this wonderfully updated home in the vibrant Crocker Amazon neighborhood of beautiful San Francisco. Boasting numerous upgrades throughout with spectacular views of downtown San Francisco and the Salesforce Tower, this amazing property features brand new interior and exterior designer paint, brand new roof with permit, gorgeous vinyl plank flooring, all new recessed lighting throughout, stylishly remodeled bathrooms, and a sleek modern kitchen with every convenience built in. Outside, enjoy the incredible backyard, positively serene and easily maintained, perfect for relaxation or entertaining guests. Whatever your lifestyle, Crocker Amazon's ideal location and distinctive community lets you create a life uniquely you, and this beautiful modern home will have you and your family living the good life for years to come. WELCOME TO YOUR NEW HOME!
